text: Every representation answers four questions. Which is the one people forget?
choices: Which programming language it was designed for
What happens to everything that does not fit — and whether that policy is loud or silent
explanation: Integer overflow wraps silently, floating point rounds silently, encoding mismatches garble silently, image compression discards silently. The machine will not tell you what it discarded, and knowing what you asked it to discard is your job.
